title: TWITTER Cyclone third-generation Sport Edition RS-24S
notes: Current exact manufacturer page identifies the third-generation Sport Edition and two wheel-dependent builds: 9.1 kg with 38 mm alloy rims or 8.9 kg with 50 mm wave-carbon rims. Both share a high-modulus-carbon frame, fork and seatpost and the same RETROSPEC/SENSAH-based 2x12 hydraulic build. Fitted 700x28C tires do not establish a maximum, and the retained card does not select one wheel option.
